# Historical compatibility fixture

`v2-demo.wproof` is the labelled synthetic demo from commit `134112f`, verified
GitHub Actions run 41205418183, `workproof-web-and-extension` artifact. The source
archive SHA-256 is `e4b168a11106521c286a8bf81ba6649a502f8f764bc669844f44d570e223a956`.
It was generated before the v3 implementation and is not re-signed during tests.
Its demo key is deliberately public, and the fixture is not real authorship evidence.
